guia.what: A page wrapper. It caps the maximum width, centers horizontally, and adds side padding (`max-w-*`, `mx-auto`, `px-*`). It replaces the `max-width + margin auto + padding` repeated in every layout, and you write it with whatever semantic element you need (`<main>`, `<section>`).
whenUse: Wrapping a page’s content so it doesn’t stretch edge to edge.
You want the same width and the same side spacing on every screen.
You need the wrapper to be a landmark (`main`, `section`).
whenAvoid: The block has to span the full width (a `banner`, a full-bleed hero).
It’s how the content is laid out inside, not the page width → `stack` or `grid`.
dos: One container per page region, not one inside another.
Choose the maximum width based on what’s being read. Long-form text wants less width, not more.
donts: Don’t nest containers. The padding doubles up.
Don’t use it as a visual box. It doesn’t draw anything → `card`.
